name: signed_trend_clarity_126d
description: OLS R-squared of ln(close) on time over the last 126 trading days, signed by the slope: a clean uptrend tends to +1, a clean downtrend to -1, no or noisy trend to ~0. Direction +1 for forward returns.
mechanism: Trend clarity (linearity of log price vs time) gated by slope direction; clean persistent trends are assumed to carry over the forward 20d horizon.
formula: y_i = ln(close_{t-125+i}), x_i = i, i=0..125; b = OLS slope; R2 = 1 - SSres/SStot; F = sign(b) * R2 in [-1, 1]; NaN unless all 126 closes valid and > 0 and SStot > 0
